name: A-I o Oshiete
source:
The protagonist somehow starts living together with a beautiful android.
Is it possible to teach her emotion? How will their relationship end up?!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ219135.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角不知为何开始与一名美丽的安卓机器人同居。
教会她理解情感，这可能吗？两人的关系最终会走向何方？！

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ219135.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
